ValidationRule.description: Name of product manufacturer cannot be edit if product manufacturer is not other
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, NOT(ISNEW()), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Non_Customer_Complaint', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Complaint' ), NOT(ISPICKVAL(IDR_Product_Manufacturer__c, 'Other')), ISCHANGED(Name_of_product_manufacturer__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Name of product manufacturer can only be updated if product manufacturer is not other
